chunks: This is the good news that God gives to His creatures who believe and do good. Say: "I ask no recompense of you for it other than obligations of relationship." We shall give more excellence to him who acquires excellence. Surely God forgives and accepts (gratitude).
ai.seo_question: What is the specific recompense the Prophet asked for in Surah Ash-Shura?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Al-Mawaddah fi al-Qurba' is interpreted as the love for the Prophet's Ahl al-Bayt, serving as a prerequisite for faith rather than merely a social courtesy. This verse underscores the balance between divine grace and human effort, promising that righteous deeds are not only accepted but multiplied by the All-Forgiving and All-Grateful God.
